children: is pursuing a roughly $600 million acquisition of Smartways Logistics from private equity firm The Riverside Company, The Australian Financial Review reported November 8.

The delivery company was expected to begin exclusive negotiations with Riverside this week, the newspaper reported, citing unidentified people familiar with the proposed sale. The discussions have not resulted in an announced agreement.
